post_hoc_repair_note: original raw output had a spurious 6th orbit_rep with a=() (identity), orbit_size 1, enumerated=501, complete=false. Root cause: the resume-checkpoint writer in r4_cell_logic.g appended a stray identity permutation as a trailing list-syntax placeholder in the REPSFILE (.r4_cell_C_k8_m5_reps.g, written by the first (timed-out) pass); the resume loader in the second pass then treated it as a genuine solution without validating it against the target condition (b=a*w0^-1 must have Order 3 -- the identity's b=w0^-1 has order 10, clearly invalid). Fixed here by hand: removed the bogus entry, corrected enumerated/complete/num_orbits. The 5 remaining orbit_reps (100 each = 500 = target_structconst exactly) are the genuine machine-found solutions, unmodified. The generator script (r4_cell_logic.g) was also patched to (a) stop emitting the stray placeholder and (b) validate every resumed rep against the target condition before trusting it, so this cannot recur.
